items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 68:1
items.html: The male of the small ZON took the Malchut of MA that remained after the VAK of MA, which the male of the great ZON took, as above. And the female of the small ZON took the Malchut of BON, meaning the Malchut of Nekudim that remained after the VAK of Nekudim, which the female of the great ZON took. (Ibid.)
